events.headline: TRUMP SAYS 'PROJECT FREEDOM' TO BE PAUSED 'FOR A SHORT PERIOD OF TIME'
events.detail: The operation guide ships through the Strait of Hormuz will be halted because progress has been made toward reaching a deal with Iran, the US president says.

events.headline: TRUMP ANNOUNCES PAUSE ON US OPERATION TO REOPEN STRAIT OF HORMUZ

events.headline: TRUMP PAUSES US MILITARY ESCORTS IN HORMUZ
